name: Cube-Chordal Ample Classes Are Not Contained in Convex-Treelike Partial Cubes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Cube-Chordal Ample Classes belongs to Convex-Treelike Partial Cubes.
proof: For m >= 4, put A_i={(i-1,i),(i+1,i)}, B_i={(i,i-1),(i,i+1)} and H_m=union_i 2^{A_i union A_{i+1}} union {A_i union B_i:i in Z_m}. This ample forbidden peripheral minor has a clique of core cubes and pairwise-disjoint simplicial leaf cubes, hence a chordal m-sun intersection graph.
comments: The complete arbitrary-m proof is preserved from the peripheral companion, thm:rper-chordal-sun-obstructions; the atlas section explicitly imports this family.
